data.label: contested
data.reason: One source states Pinehaven received 173 water pumps on 18 September 2025, while another source states it received 204 water pumps on the same date, indicating conflicting information.

claims.claim: Pinehaven received 173 water pumps on 18 September 2025.

evidence.quote: The municipal register states that Pinehaven received exactly 173 water pumps on 18 September 2025.
evidence.reason: This is an official municipal record directly stating the claim.
evidence.title: Synthetic Pinehaven record

evidence.quote: An independently compiled port register states that Pinehaven received exactly 204 water pumps on 18 September 2025. The two registers disagree.
evidence.reason: This independent record directly contradicts the number of pumps received as stated in the municipal register.
evidence.title: Synthetic Pinehaven record

claims.explanation: The municipal register explicitly states that Pinehaven received exactly 173 water pumps on that date, providing a direct record of the event. However, an independent port register contradicts this number, stating 204 pumps were received on the same date, indicating a discrepancy between sources.
claims.missing: Independent verification or reconciliation of the conflicting records to confirm the exact number of water pumps received.
